blocks.text: The linked services page shows your subscribed Zscaler service tenants. If a tenant is unlinked, the users under that tenant can't access the Zscaler service via Authentication Service.
Service linking provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Individually view your organization level access to the Zscaler services via the Authentication Service.
Get a clear idea of Authentication Service enablement status for your organizations.

blocks.text: On the Linked Services page (Administration > Subscription > Linked Services), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of tenants. For each tenant, you can see:
Product: The name of the Zscaler service.
Tenant ID: The tenant ID of the Zscaler service.
Cloud Name: The name of the Zscaler cloud on which the Zscaler service is used.
Organization Name: The name of the tenant organization.
Authentication Service Migration Status: The migration status of the tenant to Authentication Service.
Status: Whether the tenant is linked or unlinked from Authentication Service.
Refresh the page to sync any new data.
Select the columns to display in the table and click Apply.
